title: Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A classic Southeast Asian dish of marinated chicken grilled to perfection and served with peanut sauce.
instructions: 2. In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, lime juice, garlic, and ginger. Blend until smooth.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together blended marinade, soy sauce, and honey. Add chicken and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Thread marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill or oven rack with peanut oil. Grill or bake the satay for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, prepare peanut sauce by blending peanuts, peanut butter, soy sauce, and honey until smooth.
7. Serve the grilled satay with peanut sauce for dipping.
